description: One image-to-video generation job (CF-WO-P1-006-R2-PREFLIGHT, v2.5, additive). The job carries the provider elements payload (one element per character, built from the approved character-identity binding), the generate_audio flag, the output origin, and the retention headers. Output origins are the GCS fal serverless bucket (storage.googleapis.com, path /falserverless/ only) and the fal CDN v3 origin (v3b.fal.media) where actually used. ZDR is UNCONFIRMED for this endpoint and is never claimed: X-Fal-Store-IO 0 disables request-history payload storage (it is not ZDR), and the lifecycle/ACL header applies to fal CDN v3 outputs only, never to GCS outputs. multi_prompt is intentionally unused by design (one shot is one generation with a single prompt), even though the provider documents the field.

drift_review.description: Post-generation character-drift review of real generated frames (human review). No verdict exists until frames are actually reviewed.

duration.description: Clip duration in seconds, as a string enum (provider DurationEnum).

elements.description: Provider elements array: one element per character, in prompt-reference order (@Element1, @Element2, ...). The keyframe (start_image_url) is the scene composition and stays separate from this array.

frontal_image_url.description: Main frontal view of the character.

generate_audio.description: Whether the provider generates native audio for the clip. This production runs with false (no voice is bound to an element).

multi_prompt_status.description: multi_prompt is intentionally unused: one shot is one generation with a single prompt. The provider documents the field; this production does not use it.

output.description: The provider result for this job.

origin.description: Permitted output origin for this provider/model contract.

url.description: Original provider result URL, recorded in redacted form only (scheme://host/path, no query string).

retention.description: Retention headers sent with the request and their scope.

lifecycle_preference.description: X-Fal-Object-Lifecycle-Preference: expiration + initial ACL. Scope: fal CDN v3 outputs ONLY — it does NOT protect GCS outputs.

expiration_duration_seconds.description: Seconds until the fal CDN file expires (7 days by default).

initial_acl.description: Initial ACL for fal CDN v3 files: a default decision plus optional per-user rules.

store_io.description: X-Fal-Store-IO: 0 disables request-history payload storage. It does NOT equal ZDR.

zdr_status.description: Zero data retention status for this endpoint. UNCONFIRMED: never claimed.

start_image_url.description: The verified keyframe: the scene composition for this shot. Kept separate from elements.

title: ImageToVideoJob
